message.content:
The dummy main reads files from command line arguments. I can build the fuzzer with gcc (without ASAN) to verify the code path is reached, but the crash is a use-after-poison which requires ASAN to detect. Without ASAN, the read from poisoned memory would just read garbage (uninitialized data), not crash.
